chains.trait: Eight jointed legs with curved claws
links: To grip uneven basalt and climb vertical lava tube walls
The island is a stratovolcano with basalt caves (F9)

skill.effect: It scales steep rock faces and squeezes through narrow crevices with ease. You can watch it scramble up sheer walls and navigate tight passages without slipping.

chains.weakness: Slow movement speed on smooth sand.
observe: Crawls upside down in lava tube

journal.en: It walks where gravity fears to tread.

plausibility.summary: Eight-legged bilateral climbers fit island basalt lava tubes (F9) and intertidal rock (F13). Dense air (F4) increases drag but hooked claws on uneven andesite/basalt are a standard solution for cave and reef edges; eight contacts spread load on a ~450 g body at 1.05 g (F2). Fits scavenger niche D27 alongside wrack and benthic carrion (F20).
fixes: Eight-legged bilateral climbers fit island basalt lava tubes (F9) and intertidal rock (F13). Dense air (F4) increases drag but hooked claws on uneven andesite/basalt are a standard solution for cave and reef edges; eight contacts spread load on a ~450 g body at 1.05 g (F2). chains.trait: Powerful, serrated mandibles for shredding hides
links: To process large chunks of sinking carcasses quickly
Carcasses drift and sink in the turbid shallows (F20)

skill.effect: It uses its serrated jaws to rip meat from carcasses, leaving behind easily gathered scraps. You can collect the shredded remains to sustain yourself longer.

journal.en: A living garbage disposal on eight legs.

plausibility.summary: State heritage explicitly: either gnathobases/mandibles on a peracarid crustacean founder (F27), or heavy chelicerae with teeth-like projections on a xiphosuran-derived form; drop 'mandible' if the lineage is strictly arachnid.
fixes: State heritage explicitly: either gnathobases/mandibles on a peracarid crustacean founder (F27), or heavy chelicerae with teeth-like projections on a xiphosuran-derived form; drop 'mandible' if the lineage is strictly arachnid.

chains.trait: Giant compound eyes and chemosensory palps
links: To navigate dark caves and detect scent trails in turbid water
Caves are dark and shallows are turbid (F9, F20)

skill.effect: It sniffs the air and water to locate distant food sources. You can follow its movements to discover hidden carcasses nearby.

journal.en: It smells the past in the water.

fixes: Anchor to F27 founder: xiphosuran or cave amphipod/isopod; use 'antennules' for crustaceans or 'pedipalp chemosensors' for chelicerates; size eyes as 'large for the clade' not insect-scale 'giant' unless diurnal cave mouth activity is added.

chains.trait: Thick, plated carapace with gill-slits along the abdomen
links: To withstand crushing pressure in tide pools and high O2 respiration
Dense air and high oxygen (F5) and tidal ranges (F13)

skill.effect: Its thick, plated shell deflects the bites of smaller hunters. You can observe it shrugging off minor attacks while foraging safely.

journal.en: An ironclad ghost of the shallow reefs.

plausibility.summary: Replace derivation link 'crushing pressure' with wave buffeting, predation bites, and desiccation stress during low tide; specify pleopod/book gills derived under D10; note moult vulnerability for gameplay. Mass 450 g at 12 cm is heavy but plausible for a compact armoured marine scavenger (compare dense isopods)—optional journal mention, not a separate violation.
